title: После предлога: joining, leaving, checking
description: После предлога: joining, leaving, checking: применяем правило в самостоятельных ситуациях, работаем со словарём и читаем авторский текст без аудирования.
objectives: Различать interested in doing и want to do
notes: После in, without и before глагол может принимать -ing: interested in joining; without checking.
To-infinitive после want — другая модель: want to join. Не переносите её автоматически после in.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: She is interested in ___ the photography club.
Дополни предложение словом из пары: applying / apply.
exercises.explanation: После before в этой сокращённой конструкции нужна -ing-форма.

exercises.prompt: Собери предложение: «Он ушёл, не проверив адрес.»
exercises.editorial_answer: He left without checking the address.
exercises.explanation: После without требуется checking; речь об отсутствии проверки перед уходом.

exercises.prompt: Исправь указанную конструкцию, сохраняя остальные слова и смысл.

public_payload.sentence: I am interested in to learn more about design.

accepted: I am interested in learning more about design.

exercises.reference_answer: I am interested in learning more about design.
exercises.incorrect_answer: I am interested in to learn more about design.
exercises.editorial_answer: I am interested in learning more about design.
exercises.explanation: После interested in нужно learning вместо to learn.

exercises.prompt: Что Элла проверила перед подачей заявки?

public_payload.passage: Ella was interested in joining a photography club. Before applying, she read the requirements and checked whether beginners were welcome. The club asked members to bring a camera, but borrowing one was allowed. Ella contacted a friend rather than buying equipment immediately. She completed the application after confirming that she could borrow a camera for the first month.

options.label: Whether she could skip every requirement.
Whether the club sold only expensive cameras.

exercises.explanation: В первом шаге она выяснила, принимают ли начинающих.

exercises.prompt: Соедини слова урока с переводом в указанном контексте.
exercises.editorial_answer: join — присоединяться; interested — заинтересованный; application — заявка; requirement — требование
exercises.explanation: В этих контекстах: join — присоединяться; interested — заинтересованный; application — заявка; requirement — требование.

exercises.prompt: Почему она не купила камеру сразу?

public_payload.passage: Ella was interested in joining a photography club. Before applying, she read the requirements and checked whether beginners were welcome. The club asked members to bring a camera, but borrowing one was allowed. Ella contacted a friend rather than buying equipment immediately. She completed the application after confirming that she could borrow a camera for the first month.

options.label: She had already decided not to join.
Borrowing one was allowed, and a friend could lend her one.

exercises.editorial_answer: Borrowing one was allowed, and a friend could lend her one.
exercises.explanation: Разрешённый заём оборудования дал альтернативу покупке.

lines.speaker: Собеседник
lines.text: I want to join, but I have no equipment.

options.label: Ask about borrowing it before buying anything.
Ask about to borrow it before buy anything.
Ask about borrowed it before to buying.

exercises.editorial_answer: Ask about borrowing it before buying anything.
exercises.explanation: Borrowing и buying следуют за предлогами.

public_payload.sentence: A condition that applicants must meet is a ___.

options.label: suggestion that can always be ignored
